$comment: The cover illustration, which is a different job from the interior. It is full colour rather than line art, so it does not take the interior's style block — `styled: false` sends the subject as the whole prompt. Kept in its own spec so it never turns up in the book's image list, the contact sheet or the page checks.

images.subject: Bright, cheerful, eye-catching children's activity book cover illustration, vertical. A big chunky yellow excavator in the lower center with its bucket raised proudly, an orange dump truck full of golden sand beside it, a red crane in the background, and a few orange and white traffic cones and small sand piles in front. Clean modern vector cartoon style with smooth rounded toy-like shapes, thick dark outlines, bold saturated colors, and soft glossy highlights that make the vehicles look shiny and new. Sunny sky-blue background with a soft white glow and a few simple fluffy clouds. The top 40% of the image is open, uncluttered sky with no objects, for a title. Vehicles are large, sharp and fully visible, nothing cut off. Happy, energetic, high contrast. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no people, no faces on the vehicles.
